tasks.label: 准备：开发环境
tasks.command: $bun = Get-Command bun -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($bun) { & $bun.Source install --frozen-lockfile } else { npx --yes bun install --frozen-lockfile }; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; foreach ($relativePath in @('web/default/dist/index.html', 'web/classic/dist/index.html')) { $path = Join-Path '${workspaceFolder}' $relativePath; if (-not (Test-Path $path)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path (Split-Path $path) | Out-Null; [IO.File]::WriteAllText($path, '<!doctype html><title>Development placeholder</title>', [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)) } }

tasks.label: 开发：默认前端
tasks.command: $bun = Get-Command bun -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($bun) { & $bun.Source run dev -- --host 0.0.0.0 --port 5173 } else { npx --yes bun run dev -- --host 0.0.0.0 --port 5173 }
